canonical_purpose: Provide an independent, deterministic local software laboratory for multi-sensor equipment-health scoring, anomaly evaluation, simulated state transitions, and bounded diagnostic heuristics over caller-supplied synthetic/local telemetry.
consumer: Developers and reviewers evaluating reusable equipment-health software mechanisms without external hardware authority.
natural_runtime: installable local Python library and CLI
deployment_reason: The intended product is a local/reference health laboratory. A hosted or physical-control deployment would add authority and integration claims outside the verified purpose.
